quest.title: The First Resistance
quest.objective: Complete a focused 20-minute study session without checking your phone.
quest.prompt: What did you learn, or what will you change next time?

fields.action: I studied for 20 minutes and kept my phone in another room.
fields.difficulty: I wanted to check messages twice.
fields.outcome: I completed the planned study session.
fields.reflection: I learned that keeping my phone away reduced distractions. Next time I will prepare my study space before starting.

fields.action: I set a 20-minute timer and worked on my programming assignment without opening social media.
fields.difficulty: I felt the urge to check notifications.
fields.reflection: I realised that starting with a small time commitment makes it easier to focus.

fields.situation: In the college library after lunch.
fields.action: I placed my phone inside my bag and revised computer networks for 20 minutes.
fields.difficulty: People were talking nearby, which distracted me.
fields.outcome: I finished revising the topic I had planned.
fields.reflection: I learned that choosing a quieter location is important for my concentration.

fields.action: I disabled notifications and completed a focused 20-minute session.
fields.difficulty: I initially wanted to switch between applications.
fields.reflection: I noticed that removing notifications helped me maintain attention. I will repeat this approach.

fields.situation: At my study table before dinner.
fields.action: I put my phone on silent and completed 20 minutes of mathematics practice.
fields.difficulty: A message notification made me curious.
fields.outcome: I continued studying and completed the exercises.
fields.reflection: I learned that I can postpone checking messages until after completing an important task.
